big_fat_buddy: The new machine gunner is Marek "Brick" Buddy, once a railway porter from Brennmoor. The corporal asked if a railway porter was any use in a trench. Marek "Brick" Buddy said he would find out. Marek "Brick" Buddy walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Marek "Brick" Buddy had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Walter Small crossed it, Marek "Brick" Buddy fired. Walter Small was grazed.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Marek "Brick" Buddy won before reaching the end of his entry.
corporalstars: Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar stepped off the supply cart at S-F5 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar traded a lucky button for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
On sentry duty Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
staryfins: By the time Leopold Staryfins reached S-F22, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
